**No, you cannot buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier without a valid food-grade certificate**, regardless of how much better their price is.

### Policy Details:
* **Food-Contact Requirement:** The 5-litre silicone gasket (`GSK-SIL-05L`) is explicitly marked as a food-contact item in Bahi. Under **POL-PUR-001 §6.2** and **POL-SUP-003 §4.1**, any part coming into contact with food (specifically including gaskets, lids, and body blanks) may **only** be purchased from a supplier that holds a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi.
* **Timing & Validity:** The certificate must be uploaded and verified before placing an order. An expired or missing certificate is strictly treated as no certificate, and Bahi will block ordering food-contact parts from that vendor (**POL-PUR-001 §6.2**, **POL-SUP-003 §4.5**).
* **Certificate Standards:** The certificate must be a test report from an accredited food-contact materials laboratory (such as an FSSAI-notified lab) or equivalent conformity certification (**POL-SUP-003 §4.2**).

### What you can do:
If the supplier offers competitive pricing and you want to work with them, ask them to provide their food-grade laboratory test report. Once verified and uploaded to their Bahi profile, you will be able to place orders with them.
